prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while driving in Conroe, Texas. Is it all right if I record this conversation?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather keep those details off the recording for now, but I can provide them to the adjuster file afterward.

Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to move into the right lane because I needed to get off at the next exit. I checked my mirror, saw nothing right beside me, and signaled. As I started to move over, the other vehicle came up on my right side and we made contact along the passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started to merge?

A: Not clearly. It was in the blind spot area, and I didn't catch it until I was already partially over.

Q: How fast were you each traveling?

A: I'd estimate I was around the speed of traffic, maybe a little under the limit. The other car seemed to be moving a bit faster than I was.

Q: Did either vehicle leave the roadway or strike anything else?

A: No. Both of us pulled onto the shoulder after the impact. Nothing else was hit.

Q: Did you feel any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt a tightness in my lower back right away, but I didn't think much of it. By the next morning it was a lot worse, with stiffness and pain when I bent or sat for long periods.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to a clinic a couple of days later. They diagnosed a back strain and gave me instructions for physical therapy and pain management.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add before we conclude?

A: No, I think that covers it.

Q: Thank you for your time. We will follow up with you in writing.
